warm.li: Someone brings me a bowl every evening before I can ask. I'll find out who and thank them.
[bed] Out of bed at last. I went round and thanked everyone who sat with me.

blunt.li: [bed] Out of bed. Legs wobbly. Walking anyway.

cheerful.li: Walked to the window and back without stopping! Tomorrow, the door.
[illness] The fever's gone, and I've never been so glad to be bored.

gloomy.li: Weak and slow. I watch the others work and feel useless.
[bed] Out of bed, but everything takes twice as long. I hate being a burden.

cold.li: Recovering. I've drawn up a list of tasks I can manage sitting down.
[surgery] {OTHER_nameDef}'s work is holding. The stitches are clean. I'll be back on my feet soon enough.

plain.li: Stood up too fast, and the room went sideways. Back to bed, with orders.

warm.li: I wanted to help so badly I forgot I was still healing. The others put me back to bed, kindly.

blunt.li: Pushed too hard. Paid for it.

cheerful.li: I've been sent back to bed! At least the blankets are warm.

gloomy.li: One good day, then this. It's always like this.

cold.li: Exertion exceeded my current capacity. I'll pace myself more carefully.

plain.li: Hauled stone with the others today and kept up. Nobody fussed over me once.

warm.li: Back to full strength. I went round and helped everyone who'd covered my work.

cheerful.li: I'm back! I did a little jump in the yard and nobody even saw.

gloomy.li: All better. My body remembers what happened even if the others forget.

cold.li: Full strength restored. I've taken back my old duties.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came by with a handful of berries and the latest gossip. Both were sweet.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me and held my hand when the pain was bad. I won't forget it.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} visited and we played a game of guessing what's for supper. I won twice!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} sat with me today. For an hour I forgot how long I've been stuck here.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} came to see me. It costs a person an hour to visit the sick. I noticed who paid it.

plain.li: Spent the whole afternoon on {OTHER_nameDef}. Afterward I ate standing up and couldn't taste a thing.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} thanked me before I'd even finished washing my hands. It's the patients that keep me going.

cheerful.li: Another one put back together! {OTHER_nameDef} is going to be fine.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made it through. I keep going over every cut anyway.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s operation went as planned. The method holds up.

plain.li: I washed my hands three times after {OTHER_nameDef}. They still don't feel clean.

warm.li: I sat with {OTHER_nameDef} after, and told {OTHER_objective} I was sorry. It was all I had.

cheerful.li: I'll keep remembering {OTHER_nameDef} laughing before we started. I'll have to.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} trusted my hands, and my hands failed.

cold.li: I've gone over {OTHER_nameDef}'s operation step by step. The error was not where I expected.

plain.li: I've lost another, {OTHER_nameDef}. The infirmary feels like a different room tonight.

warm.li: I talked to {OTHER_nameDef} until the end. It's the only part I did right.

gloomy.li: First the last one, now {OTHER_nameDef}. My hands shake when I pick up the knife.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I'll go back over both cases tonight.

plain.li: {BABY_nameDef} arrived just before dawn. {OTHER_nameDef} was brave, and very loud about it.

warm.li: I wrapped {BABY_nameDef} in the softest blanket we have and stayed until {OTHER_nameDef} slept.

cheerful.li: {BABY_nameDef} has a grip like a blacksmith! I'm very proud of {BABY_objective} already.

gloomy.li: {BABY_nameDef} is here and breathing. Out here, I count that as a blessing every time.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} delivered {BABY_nameDef} without trouble. The preparations paid off.

plain.li: When it was over, {OTHER_nameDef} put the baby on my chest and told me I'd done well. I cried.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} held my hand through the worst of it. I'll owe {OTHER_objective} forever.

blunt.li: Baby's here. {OTHER_nameDef} knew what to do. I didn't.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made a terrible joke halfway through, and I laughed, and then there was the baby!

gloomy.li: I was sure something would go wrong. {OTHER_nameDef} didn't let it.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was calm and exact. I'll want {OTHER_objective} again, if there's a next time.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked me to name the baby anyway. We did, together, quietly.

warm.li: I helped {OTHER_nameDef} choose a place for the little grave. We picked the sunniest spot.

blunt.li: Couldn't save the baby. I'll carry that.

cheerful.li: There's nothing bright to write today. I'll sit with {OTHER_nameDef} again tomorrow.

gloomy.li: The baby never cried. I keep listening for it.

cold.li: The child didn't survive. {OTHER_nameDef} will need time, and someone watching.

plain.li: [trusted] A child brought me a scraped knee today because "you're the one who fixes things".

warm.li: [trusted] People leave little gifts at the infirmary door now. I don't know what to say to them.

blunt.li: [renowned] Everyone trusts me with their lives. I'd better keep earning it.

cheerful.li: [renowned] Someone called me the best doctor on the rim! A huge exaggeration, but I'll take it.

gloomy.li: [renowned] They all look at me as if I can't fail. I can. I have.

cold.li: [renowned] My record speaks for itself. People defer to me on matters of health now.

warm.li: [patient] {OTHER_nameDef} was so gentle with my wound. I'm in good hands.

gloomy.li: [patient] {OTHER_nameDef} patched me up again. One day it won't be enough, but not today.
